title: 301 FW Egress saves pilot lives
description: The 301st Fighter Wing Mission is to train and deploy combat ready Airmen. Airmen from the egress shop within the wing's maintenance squadron play a critical role should a F-16 fighting falcon pilot need to to eject in the event of an emergency.
